freeze.hash_definition: Instructed digest equals sha256 of json.dumps(object without packet_sha256, indent=2, sort_keys=True) plus a trailing newline. Raw file bytes are the canonical dump of the full object, including the packet_sha256 field, so the file-byte digest differs. The difference is recorded and not repaired.

methodology.financing: UNKNOWN unless a forward-points or funding-spread field exists. opportunities.carry is recorded and is not financing.
methodology.five_observations_back: history[-6] to history[-1], which is five stored steps. Requires at least six rows.
methodology.news: Headlines are narrative. They are not marks.
methodology.one_month_and_three_month: Reported only with the actual start date. obs_21 and obs_63 count stored observations, not calendar days. A separate calendar anchor uses the last stored print on or before last_date minus 30 or 91 calendar days. No forward fill.
methodology.relationships: opportunities.relationships are research prompts. Betas are omitted so they are not reused as a model.
methodology.returns: Recomputed from opportunities.series history. Simple percent is 100*(new/old-1). Log percent is 100*ln(new/old). Snapshot ret_* fields are compared and not used as the cited move.
methodology.snapshot_fx_percentiles: fx.pairs pctile_1y and pctile_5y are copied, not recomputed. The stored history is 126 rows and cannot support a 1y or 5y percentile. Scale is 0-100.
methodology.stored_percentile: weak_inclusive_pct = 100 * (count of stored values <= last) / len(history). strict_below_pct uses <. midrank_pct gives ties half weight. This is the rank inside the stored rows only.
methodology.yields: Series unit is basis points. 458 means 4.58 percent. Cited yield changes are level_change in bp.

calculations.description: Correction to revision 01: pctile_5y 0.03968253968253968 is already a percentile on a 0–100 scale. It is approximately the 0.04th percentile, not 3.97% or the 4th percentile. The November 3 spot 6.604685399731165 and z-score -2.1503642603163757 were unchanged.

November 4 shared closes: CAD/NOK 6.621871218393733 / previous 6.604685399731165 - 1 = +0.26020647%; current five-year rank 0.357142857 on the 0–100 scale, approximately the 0.36th percentile. Brent94.6200027466/103.60-1=-8.66795%; WTI88.1200027466/96.09-1=-8.29430%. These closes precede the stored forecast's 22:07 ET stated_at and cannot score it as a successful prediction.

prior_hypothesis.claim: November 5 stage-one review; no trader conclusions read and no trade instruction. Correct an error in revision 01: the November 3 CAD/NOK five-year percentile field was 0.03968254 on a 0–100 scale, meaning approximately the 0.04th percentile, not the 4th percentile. It remains a screen, not fair value. Today's shared packet supplies November 4 CAD/NOK at 6.6218712, up 0.2602% on the previous close, while Brent is 94.62 and WTI 88.12, roughly 8–9% lower than the prior packet. This makes the proposed energy-reversal channel observable in one daily move, but that close predates the forecast's November 4 22:07 ET persistence. It is context newly admitted to this review, not out-of-sample forecast success. One session cannot identify relative oil beta or establish continuation. The frozen Norges headline retains another hike as an option, which challenges a simple NOK unwind thesis. Keep long CAD/NOK conditional while comparing relative policy, growth, oil and risk components; no requirement that it hedge CORRA. No historical extreme alone or raw one-day co-move establishes an entry.

competing_explanations.statement: The five-year extreme may reflect a structural relative-rate, fiscal or external-balance change rather than a temporary energy premium.
CAD may weaken more than NOK when oil falls; a shared producer label does not establish relative beta.
Broad risk-on can support both currencies with changing relative effects. A stable historical correlation is not assumed.
The observed rise may be broad risk/USD repricing or the entire tactical reversal already realized; one daily cross return does not identify oil causality.
Norges' retained hike option could sustain NOK policy support despite cheaper oil. A complete relative policy comparison remains necessary.

falsifiers.statement: NOK outperformance persists during sustained oil declines, contradicting the assumed relative energy transmission.
Relative policy or growth repricing favors NOK enough to offset any energy-premium reversal.
The next common packet shows the cross already repriced sufficiently that the residual expected reward no longer compensates the downside and financing.

prior_hypothesis.forecast_expectation: Conditional prospective forecast: if subsequent shared evidence confirms fading energy premia and greater reversal of NOK's exceptional strength than CAD's, expect CAD/NOK appreciation over the following two to six weeks. Until that condition and a common reference price are available, this remains a candidate with no position, target or executable entry.
prior_hypothesis.horizon: 2–6 weeks after evidence confirms the stated condition; review next shared session
prior_hypothesis.instruction: November 4 closes precede stated_at 2026-11-04T22:07:17 ET. They are newly admitted context. They are not forecast success.
